verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents toggling flags independently per environment (gh-2) and offers unlimited environments (docs-59) that can be created via the Admin API (docs-16) and CLI (docs-18). SDKs authenticate with a per-environment Environment Key (docs-15), and production can be locked down via RBAC (docs-26) and release pipelines that promote flags to production (docs-6, docs-34). Missing for 10: an explicit doc walkthrough of a dev/staging/prod setup with key-scoping details (e.g., separate server-side vs client keys per environment), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
